mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate profits and drive S&P 500 returns upward over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE has been below 4.0% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust demand, which triggers positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days as companies anticipate higher revenues.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as higher rates reduce equity valuations; this effect is pronounced in the 20-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and drives S&P 500 returns upward over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in employment (PAYEMS) signal a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually), rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals central bank tightening, causing S&P 500 underperformance over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually).
